name: Aquariums on the Baltic Sea
summary: There are several large aquariums in the Baltic Sea. The app shows the best and most beautiful videos. Ozeaneum Strahlsund (aquariums, tours, penguins), Stralsund Sea Museum, Sealife Timmendorfer Strand... Dive into the underwater world and enjoy the world of underwater fish. You are in a 360° environment and see the videos on a screen. Press the X, Y, A, B buttons on the controllers to display the various videos.
